description: This file defines a React custom hook named `useGame` that manages the state and logic for a memory flip card game. It interacts with a backend API for creating, resetting, and flipping game sessions, maintains game state including board, moves, timer, and best scores, and provides actions for controlling the game.

methods.name: formatTime(seconds)
methods.description: Utility to format seconds into mm:ss string.

methods.name: toBoard(cards)
methods.description: Converts backend card data into the UI board model.

methods.name: bestKey(size)
methods.description: Computes localStorage key for storing best scores based on board size.

methods.name: loadBest(size)
methods.description: Reads the best score for a given size from localStorage.

methods.name: saveBest(size, candidate)
methods.description: Saves a new best score if it improves on the previous stored score.

methods.name: startNewGame
methods.description: Initializes a new game session by calling backend API. Sets up game state and resets timer.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the current game using backend API, or starts a new one if none exists.

methods.name: reconcileSession
methods.description: Synchronizes local state with backend session data after flip actions.

methods.name: flip
methods.description: Handles a card flip with optimistic UI updates, manages server communication, and handles match logic.
